name: syns
description: Syns for Claude Code: one install for syncing and pages over your Syns files.

plugins.name: syns
plugins.description: Everything Syns gives Claude Code, in one install: syns-sync and syns-pages (with Unife Pages).

plugins.name: syns-sync
plugins.description: Installs the Syns CLI if it is missing; pulls on session start and syncs on every Stop, continuing the agent only when a resolution is required.

plugins.name: syns-pages
plugins.description: Agent-written pages read and write the session's Syns repository (syns.*), through the Syns CLI. Brings in Unife Pages.

plugins.name: unife-pages
plugins.description: Unife Pages: every agent session gets a page it writes for you and you answer from.
